candidates.violated_requirement: Incorrect Gray-to-binary conversion for bit 0 due to using OR instead of XOR, causing wrong binary values and subsequent incorrect Gray code output
candidates.spec_basis: The implementation should correctly convert Gray code to binary representation using XOR operations between adjacent bits

candidates.violated_requirement: Binary increment operation fails to actually increment, causing the counter to stay at the same value instead of progressing through the Gray code sequence
candidates.spec_basis: The counter should increment the binary value by 1 before converting back to Gray code

candidates.violated_requirement: Incorrect binary-to-Gray conversion due to using AND instead of XOR, breaking the single-bit-change property of Gray code
candidates.spec_basis: The implementation should correctly convert binary to Gray code using XOR between the binary value and its right-shifted version

candidates.violated_requirement: Incorrect Gray-to-binary conversion for bit 1 by XORing with wrong bit (bit 3 instead of bit 2), causing cascading errors in lower bits
candidates.spec_basis: The implementation should correctly convert Gray code to binary representation using XOR operations between adjacent bits
